text_block_list.text:
Мэйсё Дото dominates the year-end
Grand Prix!
She stands at the highest
peak, surpassing both
Т.М. Опера О and
the previous generation.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This is not by coincidence, or so Grass
Wonder
believes. She relates Meisho
Doto's win as
inevitable, a flower coming
into full bloom while
hiding in the
shadow of Т.М. Опера О.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
There is still a ways to go on her path to
find true
confidence. Nonetheless...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The racer who sought hope at rock
bottom has
emerged triumphant,
becoming a beacon of hope
for many.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
